contentText: Despite the ceasefire, conditions in Gaza remain perilous for many residents, with UNICEF reporting that more than 100 children have been killed by military action since the truce began. Large numbers of people are living in makeshift tent camps that offer little protection from harsh weather, while many buildings remain structurally unsafe following Israeli bombardments. On Tuesday, at least four people were killed when a wall collapsed onto their tent in Gaza. Ellen Gainsford reports.
